acceptance_criteria: Add a decision engine entry point that emits rule-level fallback results for Phase 3 and Phase 4 rules from sop_registry.py.
Phase 3 model/vision rules return ASSIST with MODEL_REVIEW_REQUIRED and no production authority until an approved model and supervised QC process exist.
Phase 4 post-MVP rules return NOT_EVALUATED with RULE_POST_MVP_DISABLED; Phase 4 assist/model-dependent rules return ASSIST with MODEL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Aggregate Phase 3/4 decision never maps fallback states to PASS; it returns ASSIST when any rule needs review, otherwise NOT_EVALUATED for purely disabled rules.
Rule evidence includes rule id, category, registry authority, fallback source, and production-enabled state.
Invalid phase input is rejected explicitly.
Add tests and docs proving fallback behavior is registry-driven, fail-safe, and non-authoritative.

memory_preflight.query: flange_qc_v2 phase 3 phase 4 SOP safe fallback evaluator model dependent post MVP registry
retrieved_decisions: Detector observations never decide final PASS/NG.
Model-dependent rules can remain NOT_EVALUATED, ASSIST, or BLOCKED.
Post-MVP rules must not map to PASS.
retrieved_lessons: Use registry metadata as the source for safe fallback decisions.
Keep model, camera, and MLOps lanes separate from deterministic app-code scaffolds.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-025 PR to remove Phase 3/4 fallback evaluator changes, tests, docs, and gate evidence. No production data migration, model rollback, hardware rollback, or deploy rollback is required.
